CTX.name: Identity & access
CTX.desc: Who can act in the system and which client data they may see. Staff and client identities are kept separate.

CTX.name: Client relationship
CTX.desc: The household is the client relationship: the unit for advice, portal access, onboarding and reporting.

CTX.name: Party graph
CTX.desc: People and legal entities, their details, and the typed relationships between them.

CTX.name: Documents
CTX.desc: Stored files, what they relate to, and documents still outstanding.

CTX.name: Onboarding & compliance
CTX.desc: Onboarding cases, KYC, screening, suitability and the human decisions behind them.

CTX.name: Accounts & instruments
CTX.desc: Accounts at custodians, mandates, instruments, prices, FX rates and custodian-reported positions.

CTX.name: Ledger & tax lots
CTX.desc: Every transaction on every account, the tax lots they open, and the realised gain on each sale.

CTX.name: Audit, content & lineage
CTX.desc: The audit trail, approved content shown to clients, and the origin of imported data.

ENT.desc: Any actor that can perform an action: a staff member, a client login or a system service. Every audit event and review decision references one.

ENT.desc: A period in which a staff member works inside one household’s data, with a stated reason. Every action in it is audited against the session.
An advisor responsible for a household, with history.
The client relationship: the unit for advisor assignment, portal access, onboarding and reporting. A household is not a legal party and cannot own accounts.

ENT.desc: Places a person or legal entity in a household for a period.

Metadata for a stored file. The file itself is held in object storage under object_key.

A document that must be provided for a record, and its status.

Required when status is overridden
